issues.title: Acceptance Criteria Mismatch

issues.title: Ambiguous 'Working Directory' for Multi-Module
issues.why: The spec forbids 'cd' and mandates 'working-directory', but doesn't define how to resolve the path for the 'extension subdirectory' vs 'root' in a monorepo context.
issues.fix: Define a standard variable (e.g., PROJECT_ROOT) and provide a mapping table for component-to-path resolution.
